Meta.title: e-Licensing | Business licensing system
Meta.description: File a license application once, submit documents once, and track every agency's status in one place.

Home.title: Licensing for every type of business
Home.lead: File license applications in one place. No duplicate documents, clear steps, and progress you can follow in one view.
Home.step1Desc: Browse all business types and pick the license category that fits yours.
Home.step2Desc: Verify your identity and set up your business profile.
Home.step3Desc: Attach the required documents once instead of filing them with each agency separately.
Home.step4Desc: See the status of every license application on the dashboard.
Home.note1: Check which licenses you need before applying to avoid resubmitting documents.
Home.note2: Upload documents once, then follow the status on the dashboard.
Home.note3: If a step still needs original paper documents, the system tells you what to do next.
Home.note4: Not sure where to start? Begin with the Register business menu and follow the steps in order.
Home.stampsFoot: File once; each agency stamps its own decision.
